subject: Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance Update RFP
overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole met to review and amend a draft request for proposals for a consultant to execute a comprehensive update of the city's zoning ordinance. The committee approved several amendments regarding vendor criteria, scope of services, work quality standards, and submission requirements.

items.title: Evaluation Criteria for Zoning RFP
items.summary: The committee approved an amendment raising the project experience threshold for highly advantageous vendor criteria from five to seven prior similar projects.

items.title: Scope of Services Amendments
items.summary: The committee approved revisions to the RFP scope of services to explicitly incorporate housing needs, the updated digital zoning map, comprehensive plan implementation guidelines, potential state zoning changes, and climate plan targets.

items.title: Workmanship Quality Standards and CPO Review
items.summary: The committee voted to add work quality language ensuring error-free deliverables and approved sending the updated draft to the Chief Procurement Officer for final review.

items.title: Project Timeline and Submission Checklist
items.summary: The committee approved an amendment adding a mandatory submission document checklist—including a work plan, timeline, and qualifications—while retaining the anticipated project schedule running through June 2025.
